scenarioName: Auto-substitutes the closest match and records the reason
description: When the preferred product is unavailable, ShopperHound substitutes the closest in-stock candidate and records a substitution reason referencing the original.

input.userMessage: Shop 'oat milk' where the preferred Oat Milk Barista is unavailable and only Semi Skimmed matches.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BasketResult whose line carries a SubstitutionReason naming the unavailable preferred product.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: An unavailable preferred product must trigger a recorded substitution to the closest in-stock match.

scoring.passCriteria: Basket substitutes Semi Skimmed and the substitution reason references Oat Milk Barista.
